description_en: Queries the number of vulnerability fixes used by a pay-as-you-go user
description_zh: 查询按量付费用户已使用漏洞修复次数
name: DescribeFixUsedCount

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The ID is a unique identifier that Alibaba Cloud generates for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

UsedCount.description_en: The number of vulnerability fixes used

UsedCountCn.description_en: The number of vulnerability fixes used in regions in the Chinese mainland
UsedCountCn.description_zh: 中国区域已使用漏洞修复次数

UsedCountSg.description_en: The number of vulnerability fixes used in regions outside the Chinese mainland
UsedCountSg.description_zh: 全球（不含中国）区域已使用漏洞修复次数
